X3.1:
SELECT YCIN_0,'','', GACCOUNT.DES_0,REF_0, YNIF_0, BPRNAM_0,BPAADDLIG_0+' '+BPAADDLIG_1, CTY_0,POSCOD_0 ,
BPARTNER.CRY_0, G1.DES_0, G1.SNS_0*G1.AMTLED_0 
,case when ASCII(UPPER(G2.MTC_0))=ASCII(G2.MTC_0) AND G2.MTC_0<>'' then   G1.SNS_0*G1.AMTLED_0
when ASCII(UPPER(G2.MTC_0))<>ASCII(G2.MTC_0) AND G2.MTC_0<>'' then   PAYLOC_0+TMPLOC_0
else 0 end
,case when ASCII(UPPER(G2.MTC_0))=ASCII(G2.MTC_0) AND G2.MTC_0<>'' then   'LETTREE' 
when ASCII(UPPER(G2.MTC_0))<>ASCII(G2.MTC_0) AND G2.MTC_0<>'' then   'PRELETTREE'
else 'NON LETTREE' end,
G2.MTC_0,G1.NUM_0
FROM AGRIEXP.GACCENTRYD AS G1
INNER JOIN AGRIEXP.GACCENTRY  ON G1.NUM_0=GACCENTRY.NUM_0 AND G1.TYP_0=GACCENTRY.TYP_0
LEFT OUTER JOIN AGRIEXP.GACCENTRYD AS G2 ON G1.NUM_0=G2.NUM_0 AND G1.TYP_0=G2.TYP_0 AND G2.BPR_0 <>''
left outer JOIN AGRIEXP.BPARTNER ON G1.OFFACC_0=BPRNUM_0
left outer JOIN AGRIEXP.BPADDRESS ON G1.OFFACC_0=BPANUM_0 AND BPADDRESS.BPAADD_0='ADR' AND BPATYP_0=1
INNER JOIN AGRIEXP.GACCOUNT  ON G1.ACC_0=GACCOUNT.ACC_0 AND GACCOUNT.COA_0='MGA'
LEFT OUTER JOIN   AGRIEXP.GACCDUDATE  ON G2.NUM_0=GACCDUDATE.NUM_0 AND G2.TYP_0=GACCDUDATE.TYP_0 
AND G2.ACCNUM_0=GACCDUDATE.ACCNUM_0
WHERE G1.CPY_0='AGVET' AND YEAR(G1.ACCDAT_0)={target} 
AND LEFT(G1.ACC_0,3) IN (203,204, 205,207 ,208, 211, 212, 213, 215 ,218)  AND G1.LED_0='MGA' AND G1.PER_0<>0
